name: ree-go
description: ReeGo — Electron MVP for web-game workflow recording and replay

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && cross-env ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron . --no-sandbox
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 electron . --no-sandbox
scripts.smoke: npm run build && cross-env REEGO_HEADLESS=1 node scripts/smoke.mjs
scripts.postinstall: playwright install chromium && electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 || true
